caseName: Keco Industries, Inc. v. Cincinnati & Suburban Bell Telephone Co.
caseNameFull: KECO INDUSTRIES, INC. v. CINCINNATI & SUBURBAN BELL TELEPHONE CO.
attorneys: Joseph A. Segal for appellants., Carl M. Jacobs, Jr. for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
